# Contact Relationship Management

> A demo contact relationship management (CRM) system: sales automation, marketing automation, customer support and analytics. A Rust JSON API (Loco: Axum, SeaORM, PostgreSQL) and a Svelte 5 / SvelteKit 3 browser client built on the Lily Design System, specified in spec/. Demo software: synthetic data only, no real email is sent by default, no accreditation or certification is claimed.

- The specification in spec/ is the single source of truth; code and docs follow it.
- Requirements are CRM-R<n> (spec/requirements.md); tasks are CRM-T<n> (spec/tasks.md). Every task traces to a requirement.
- Be honest about limits: tasks.md records what was verified and what was not. Do not claim more than it does.
- Translations (eight UI locales, role briefs in locales/) are machine drafts that no native speaker has reviewed.
- Never put real personal data in examples, tests or fixtures; use synthetic data.

- [Tutorial: the family bridges](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/docs/tutorial-family-bridges.md): Configure the bridges to the worker service: the environment variables, a signed hire event sent with curl, and the employment check.
- [Specification index](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/index.md): Entry point to the specification.
- [Purpose](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/purpose.md): The problem and what the CRM provides.

- [Regulatory position](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/regulatory.md): Why this is demo software and what that means.

## Specification

- [Requirements](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/requirements.md): Numbered requirements (CRM-R1 to CRM-R94) with acceptance criteria.
- [Tasks](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/tasks.md): The delivery checklist (CRM-T0 to CRM-T163) with resolutions, verification and stated limits.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/architecture.md): Components and data flow.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/domain-model.md): Entities and relationships, held as relationship wrappers over upstream URNs.
- [Design decisions](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/design.md): Numbered design decisions (CRM-D1 to CRM-D18).
- [Authentication and authorisation](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/auth.md): Personas, masking and record-level access.
- [Audit](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/audit.md): The audit trail and events.
- [Sales automation](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/sales-automation.md): Leads, scoring, pipelines, deals, forecasting.
- [Marketing automation](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/marketing-automation.md): Consent, segments, campaigns, nurture.
- [Service and support](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/service-support.md): Tickets, SLAs, knowledge base.
- [Analytics and reporting](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/analytics-reporting.md): Dashboards and the honesty rules for derived numbers.
- [Integrations](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/integrations.md): The upstream services CRM consumes (it holds EntityRef URNs and never duplicates upstream records) and how.
- [Testing](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/testing.md): Test strategy.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/roadmap.md): What comes beyond the v1 task queue.
- [Production-readiness plan](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/plan.md): Engineering assessment of what stands between this demo and use by medical or governmental organisations (not a legal opinion).
- [Glossary](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/glossary.md): Terms.
- [Special files for public repos](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/special-files-for-public-repos/index.md): The top-level files a public repository carries, and why.
- [Locales for global sharing](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/locales-for-global-sharing-with-svelte/index.md): How content, the interface and documents are offered in many locales.
- [Locales for roles](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/locales-x-for-roles/index.md): How the role briefs in locales/ are laid out: one file per role per locale.

## Security and compliance

- [Security policy](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Reporting vulnerabilities.
- [Compliance evidence pack](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/index.md): Control mapping, DPIA template, runbook; not a certification.
- [Operations runbook](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/operations-runbook.md): Hardening, backup, keys, logging, release verification.
- [Penetration test scope](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/penetration-test-scope.md): Brief for an independent tester (no test has been done).
- [Accessibility audit brief](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/accessibility-audit-brief.md): Test plan for a manual audit (none has been done).
- [First release checklist](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/first-release-checklist.md): The dry run that proves release signing.
- [Control mapping](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/control-mapping.md): Controls mapped to NIST, HIPAA, ISO and GDPR references, each marked Implemented, Partial, Deployer or Gap; not a certification.
- [DPIA template](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/dpia-template.md): A pre-filled data protection impact assessment for the deploying organisation to complete.
- [API lifecycle](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/api-lifecycle.md): API errors, what counts as a breaking change, and how an endpoint, field or version is retired.
- [Email provider brief](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/email-provider-brief.md): What to hand a prospective email provider and the people who sign for it (CRM-T39); picks no vendor.
- [DPIA](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/dpia.md): The data protection impact assessment for the demo as built.
- [Personal data inventory](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/personal-data-inventory.md): Every personal-data field, where it is held and for how long.
- [Record of processing](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/record-of-processing.md): The GDPR Article 30 record for the demo.
- [Risk management](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/risk-management.md): A starting hazard analysis in the manner of ISO 14971, for an organisation that gives the software a medical purpose.
- [GDS API review](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/gds-api-review.md): A self-review of the API against the UK Government Digital Service standards (a draft).
- [DTAC supporting statements](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/spec/compliance/dtac-supporting.md): Draft answers for the NHS DTAC v2.0 form.
- [DTAC assessment](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/docs/united-kingdom/national-health-service/digital-technology-assessment-criteria/2.0/index.md): Self-assessment against the NHS Digital Technology Assessment Criteria v2.0, with its checklist.
- [DTAC checklist](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/docs/united-kingdom/national-health-service/digital-technology-assessment-criteria/2.0/checklist.md): The DTAC v2.0 questions the assessment answers.
- [AI statement](https://github.com/contact-relationship-management/contact-relationship-management/blob/main/AI_STATEMENT.md): How AI was used in this project.

## Commands

- full check: `scripts/ci-check.sh`
- service tests (the --ignored ones need DATABASE_URL): `cd contact-relationship-management-service-with-rust && cargo test --features keycloak && cargo test --features keycloak -- --ignored --test-threads=1`
- ui tests: `cd contact-relationship-management-ui-with-svelte && pnpm install && pnpm test && pnpm exec playwright test`
- ui live tests (need a running service on :5160): `pnpm test:live`
- guided tour (no service needed): `cd contact-relationship-management-ui-with-svelte && pnpm dev, then sign in as example@example.com`
